plants.name: Prunus × yedoensis
plants.description: Before its leaves appear, this small, graceful tree is covered in airy clouds of pale pink to white blossoms. The petals drift down in the spring breeze like confetti and carpet the ground beneath the branches.
plants.bloomingSeason: Peak bloom in April, with the tree flowering in early spring before it leafs out
plants.location: Olympia, Washington State, USA, where the cherries on the State Capitol campus bloom in April
plants.funFact: The Yoshino cherry is a hybrid, and its blossoms open all at once before the leaves. This is why whole avenues seem to burst into bloom overnight.

plants.name: Lupinus texensis
plants.description: Dense spikes of deep blue, pea-like flowers tipped with white spill across roadsides and meadows. Together they form a rolling blue carpet that is the signature sight of Texas in spring.
plants.bloomingSeason: Peak bloom from late March to mid-April, which includes April 8
plants.location: Texas Hill Country and Central Texas, USA
plants.funFact: Texas made the bluebonnet its state flower in 1901. In 1971 the designation was expanded to cover every Lupinus species found in the state.
